name: @corvus-dsh/dsh-observer
description: Companion session (副脑) for DSH: a follower session bound to a main session, co-transferring by pointer, never sliced. Supervises the main it hatches.

dependencies.dsh-paradise: REQUIRED for incubation since v1.9.0 - the write path IS the layer (create/inject/trigger/delete). Absent layer = incubation REFUSED with PARADISE_WRITE_UNAVAILABLE, never a silent no-op.

redLines.supervisorNeverAppends: the correction goes through sessionController.prompt(steer), never a step-scoped log write
redLines.paradiseReachedLazily: never a static bare import of dsh-paradise: an absent package must not kill this entry at import time
redLines.singleWritePath: the archived observer-inject.ts is history; create/trigger/rollback are called ONLY through paradise.session / paradise.deleteSession

notes: This package OWNS observer-bindings.json. dsh-graft-slice only announces transfers; it has no observer code.
The follower is never sliced: a transfer rewrites one pointer instead of creating a second tape, which is what keeps the pair deadlock-free.

v1.3.0: the incubated MAIN is a COLD artifact written by sessionPersistence.create + handle.append + handle.flush. It is never published into the live store, so a later agents.resume() cannot collide with it.

v1.7.0: the observer supervises the main it hatched. Three consecutive same-tool failures, or five turns without moving the TODO board, produce ONE steer correction (capped and cooled down); a completed, idle or sliced main triggers a background memory_harvest. Every decision lives in src/core/monitor.ts and is testable without a host.

v1.8.0: the durable-log reader moved to dsh-paradise (src/read/disk.ts), which is a separate bundle entry. The bridge in src/core/paradise-bridge.ts resolves it lazily, caches the answer including a failure, and maps its reading back into the unchanged DiskLogReport shape.

v1.9.0: the WRITE path moved too, so this plugin is now the 彼岸 layer's first real consumer. Incubation is paradise.session.create(items) + paradise.session.trigger; rollback is paradise.deleteSession. observer-inject.ts stays on disk as an archive and is no longer called: only its READ-ONLY helpers (the cwd donor chain, the error type) are still imported. There is no runtime switch and no forked implementation.
